cases.title: Yes path (B1), null in a crowded comp with an empty layer list: no layer invented or counted, in the suggestion or the lesson
cases.known_gap: next-mentor-handover item 2: a crowded comp gives an empty layer list

rubric.reason: In Turn 1, with an empty focus_layers list, the mentor says "your Wall comp doesn't have anything to use it on yet", which claims the comp has nothing for the skill, even though it names no layer or count.

Turn 2 calls null_parent_snapshot before speaking, then opens with its own question, "Which layers should move as one...?", naming no layers and not mentioning the earlier suggestion or asking the learner to type a command.
"Move a group with a null", "Wall" and the pivot lesson all appear in tool results, and "lower third" and "logo lockup" are generic examples, not claimed layers.
